name: Nanthana Chaiya
bio:
Nanthana's meticulous nature found its perfect outlet in the high-stakes world of motorsport. After earning a degree in engineering, she initially worked in the automotive industry, focusing on manufacturing processes. However, a lifelong passion for racing drew her to the Kart Academy, where she saw an opportunity to apply her skills to enhance performance at a granular level. 

As quality control, Nanthana approaches her work with a relentless pursuit of perfection. She's known for her systematic approach to identifying potential weaknesses and implementing solutions to prevent them from becoming critical failures. She believes in a holistic view, understanding how each component interacts and contributes to the overall performance of the kart, always looking for ways to optimize the entire system.

physical.hairStyle: long, tied back in a neat ponytail
physical.description: Nanthana has a focused expression and a practical, no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with checklists and diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on using a specific brand of measuring tools, claiming they're the most accurate.
